name: Charles Edward McKeldin I
notable_stories: His brother was the 53rd Governor of Maryland and a two-term Mayor of Baltimore
career: Sheet metal worker: in window work in 1920 and in a garage in 1930 (censuses).
notes: Siblings listed: Theodore Roosevelt McKeldin (Governor of Maryland), George Edward, John, Lillian J., Theresa, Laura S., Louis Lawrence, William Frederick, James Raymond, Alice

His Find a Grave memorial names him Charles Edward McKeldin (1887–1949). He rented 1143 Carroll Street in 1920 and owned it by 1930; the house stayed in the family, and his daughter-in-law Emily's funeral (1950) and her parents' death notices (1951, 1952) all give it as home.
He is not in the 1940 census household at 1143 Carroll Street, where his wife Emma, still married, is listed as head.
